findings.claim: --timeout is unbounded above; under Node (the shipped runtime) a value above 2147483 seconds silently aborts the request in ~1ms with only a TimeoutOverflowWarning, and above 4294967 seconds AbortSignal.timeout throws RangeError inside the job callback
findings.evidence: node v24: `--timeout 3600000` -> 3600000000 ms -> aborted=true after 52ms with 'TimeoutOverflowWarning: 3600000000 does not fit into a 32-bit signed integer. Timeout duration was set to 1.'; `--timeout 4294968` -> 'RangeError: The value of "delay" is out of range. It must be >= 0 && <= 4294967295'. Driven through the real parsePositiveInt + timeoutMs from the diff. Same script under Bun stays pending, so bun test cannot see it.
findings.layer: runtime timer contract of the shipped binary (node), end-to-end from user input

findings.evidence: Per-file diff of every .option/.argument/.description/.command/.action call between origin/main and the worktree: identical modulo line numbers. findings.claim: addTimeoutOption composes wrongly with the homegrown parser (defaults, negated flags, -- terminator, missing/malformed values, parent/subcommand inheritance)
findings.evidence: 21 probe cases driven through the real registered program: default applied when absent; `--timeout 600` and `--timeout=600` both 600; repeated flag last-wins; missing value -> CliUsageError "option '--timeout <seconds>' argument missing"; abc/0/-1/3.5/' 30' rejected with the parse.ts message; `audio speak --no-play --no-waveform --timeout 30` yields timeout=30 with both negations intact; `--timeout` before the subcommand correctly rejected as unknown option on the parent; `--` terminator behavior unchanged from base.

Grep for other documented second-values across apps/web and both READMEs found none. The stated drift did not exist; the claim in the change description is unsubstantiated, not a defect.

issue_candidates.title: README 'All commands support' block does not hold for ai models
issue_candidates.evidence: models.ts registers only --type/--creator/--json; the block lists -m/-o/-n/-p/-q/--json and now --timeout.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: Pre-existing inaccuracy for four flags; the diff only inherits it by adding a fifth line to the same block.

issue_candidates.title: parsePositiveInt has no upper bound and returns non-integers for very long digit strings
issue_candidates.evidence: parse.ts:1-10 accepts /^\d+$/ then parseInt; 30 nines returns 1e30. Shared by -n, -p, --max-tokens, --timeout.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: Fixing the shared parser affects flags outside this change; F1 can be closed locally with a ceiling in addTimeoutOption.

issue_candidates.title: Bun and Node disagree on timer delay limits, so bun test cannot catch timer-range regressions in the shipped binary
issue_candidates.evidence: Identical script: Node overflows at 2^31-1 and throws above 4294967295; Bun accepts 9999999999000 and only throws above 2^53-1.
issue_candidates.why_out_of_scope: A CI/runtime-parity concern for the repo, not a defect of this diff, though it is why F1 survived a green suite.
